name: TreeView
description: A hierarchy of items, such as files in folders or pages in sections, that people expand, collapse and select. Follows the WAI-ARIA tree pattern.
whenToUse: To browse nested content more than two levels deep, e.g. a file explorer.
To pick one item from a hierarchy, e.g. a folder to move a file into.

whenNotToUse.text: For a site’s main navigation with one or two levels.
To show and hide sections of a page.
For a flat list of items.

anatomy.name: Row
anatomy.description: One item: chevron, optional icon and label, indented by level.

anatomy.name: Chevron
anatomy.description: Shows whether a branch is open; only on items with children.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: Identifies the kind of item, e.g. folder or file.

anatomy.name: Guide
anatomy.description: Lines connecting children to their parent.

values.meaning: Default. Indentation alone shows the levels.
Adds lines down each open branch, for deep trees.

states.name: Collapsed
states.meaning: A branch whose children are hidden.

states.name: Hover
states.meaning: Highlights the row under the pointer.

states.name: Focus
states.meaning: Shows which row the keyboard is on.

behavior.text: Clicking a row selects it; clicking a branch also opens or closes it.
Pass expanded / selected with their change handlers to control them, or the default props to let the tree manage them.
The tree is a single tab stop; arrow keys move between rows.
Indentation and chevrons flip, and Left / Right arrows swap meaning.

content: Keep labels short; long labels are truncated with an ellipsis.
Use icons consistently: the same icon for every item of the same kind.
Name the tree with label, e.g. "Files" or "Pages".

guidelines.do: Open the branch that holds the selected item.
guidelines.dont: Start with the selected item hidden in a closed branch.
guidelines.why: People need to see where they are.

guidelines.do: Use guides for trees deeper than three levels.
guidelines.dont: Rely on indentation alone in deep trees.
guidelines.why: Lines make it clear which parent a row belongs to.

guidelines.do: Use a tree for real hierarchies.
guidelines.dont: Use a tree for a flat list or for page navigation.
guidelines.why: Tree keyboard behavior is unexpected where there is no hierarchy.

accessibility.role: tree, with treeitem rows and group for each branch’s children.

keyboard.action: Move to the previous or next visible row.
Opens a closed branch, or moves to its first child.
Closes an open branch, or moves to the parent.
Move to the first or last visible row.
Selects the row and opens or closes a branch.

aria.when: On branches: whether they are open.
On every row: whether it is selected.
On every row: its depth, starting at 1.

accessibility.focus: One row is focusable at a time (roving tabindex); a ring outlines the focused row.

wcag.how: Levels and nesting are exposed with tree roles and aria-level.
Every action works with the arrow keys, Enter and Space.
Expanded and selected states are exposed on each row.

notes: Selection is shown by background and weight, not color alone.

examples.title: File tree
examples.description: Folders with icons, one branch open.

examples.title: Controlled selection
examples.code:
import { TreeView } from '@ds/react';

<TreeView label="Pages" items={pages} selected={page} onSelect={setPage} />

examples.title: Deep tree with guides
examples.code:
import { TreeView } from '@ds/react';

<TreeView label="Components" items={items} size="small" guides />

related.relation: Use for app navigation with one or two levels.
Use to show and hide page sections.

components.name: TreeView
components.description:
A hierarchy of items, like files in folders, that people expand, collapse and select.
Implements the WAI-ARIA tree pattern with a single tab stop and arrow-key navigation.

defaultExpanded.description: Ids of branches open at first.

guides.description: Draws lines that connect children to their parent.

--tree-view-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--tree-view-indent.description: Gap between groups inside a section.

--tree-view-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--tree-view-duration.description: Elements changing size or position: accordions, tabs.

--tree-view-easing.description: Moving between two states on screen.

--tree-view-medium-item-padding-y.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--tree-view-small-item-padding-y.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--tree-view-item-gap.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--tree-view-item-border-radius.description: Small rounding for tiny elements: checkboxes, tags.

--tree-view-item-hover-bg-color.description: Subtle tinted background for a tone, e.g. alerts, selected items, badges.

--tree-view-item-selected-bg-color.description: Subtle tinted background for a tone, e.g. alerts, selected items, badges.

--tree-view-item-selected-text-color.description: Main tone-colored text on light or tinted backgrounds: titles, active items.

--tree-view-icon-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--tree-view-guide-color.description: Outline of text fields, selects and comboboxes; the lightest gray with 3:1 contrast.

--tree-view-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

--tree-view-focus-ring-color.description: Focus ring color; follows the brand accent.
